info.title: SketchForge REST API v1 (contracted subset)
info.description: Generated from the runtime-facing API operation registry. This document contains only operations whose request, query, and response metadata can be represented accurately. X-SketchForge-Metadata.description: URI-encoded JSON containing the export metadata fields (format, filename, mimeType, shapeCount, and optional STEP skipped-shape details).

404.description: Resource not found or API disabled.

post.description: Export project geometry as JSON/base64, or return the raw artifact when download=1. Binary downloads carry result metadata in the X-SketchForge-Metadata response header.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set download=1 to return raw artifact bytes; omitted or any other value returns JSON with base64 content.

oneOf.description: A single non-empty shape ID is accepted as shorthand.
IDs are trimmed and must be distinct after trimming.

name.description: Optional output basename; an empty or omitted value uses the project name.

view.description: SVG only; section and view are mutually exclusive.

section.description: SVG or DXF only; section and view are mutually exclusive.

index.description: Zero-based index used by shell requests.

id.description: Application-owned face ID; use it as the faceColors key in PATCH /api/v1/shapes.

surfaceType.description: Surface kind reported by the CAD kernel, or unknown when unavailable.

get.description: Lists each face with its shell-request index and stable application-owned ID. Use topology=exact to list analytic faces on supported plain full-turn sketch revolves without changing the default mesh listing. Face IDs can be used as faceColors keys in PATCH /api/v1/shapes.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Whitespace is trimmed before validation. ID starts with a letter or digit and contains only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

parameters.name: shapeId
parameters.description: Whitespace is trimmed; the remaining value must not be empty.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.description: Optional. Use exact to list analytic B-rep faces on a supported plain full-turn sketch revolve; the default mesh listing keeps its existing indexes.
